notes: Early high range, mid-year slide and capitulation wick, V recovery to near prior highs, then one large down gap and partial rebound to MA50/MA200 cluster. Choppy.
Uptrend then 6-month top range, then sharp decline to new lows on rising volume; last ~15 bars bounce off the low. MA50 rolling over below a now-falling MA200.
Persistent staircase uptrend all year, higher highs and higher lows, shallow pullbacks to MA50; decision bar gaps up to a new 252-session high. Volume unremarkable.
Opens with a crash from the year's high, mid-year recovery, then a slow lower-highs decline to near the year's low; MA50 below falling MA200.
Down gap and slide early, V recovery with up gap, uptrend into a choppy range near highs; last bars: one-day spike to a new high immediately reversed back to MA50.
Large down gap early, base, slow uptrend with MA50 crossing MA200; ~20 bars before the end a large up gap on heavy volume to a new year high, held and drifted sideways near the top.
Range, then mid-year crash and double bottom on heavy volume, gap-up V recovery, then staircase higher to a new year high at the decision bar; volume calmer in the advance.
Flat range, brief spike high mid-year, then lower highs and a sharp capitulation leg; final bars rebound back to the falling MA50 on heavier volume.
Gap-driven chart: gap up to a plateau, gap down, then a very large gap down on the year's heaviest volume; afterwards a 4-month base and a gradual rise above MA50, still below MA200.
Long decline to a capitulation low, gap-up reversal on heavy volume, then a steady lower-volatility staircase advance; decision bar in a shallow pullback touching the rising MA50 just below the high.
Gap-down crash early, recovery to a year high, then a gap-led decline to a double bottom; last two months a steady rally back up to the falling MA200 (MA50 still below MA200).

Flat-to-down first third ending in a high-volume capitulation low, V recovery, then a long orderly staircase uptrend with pullbacks holding the rising MA50; decision bar a shallow dip just below the high.
High range, gap down, then a long lower-highs decline; final four months a sideways base around a flattening MA50 well below the falling MA200.
Early decline (one huge-volume bar), long base, gradual uptrend; last ~2 months an accelerating leg with an up gap to new highs far above the MA50, then a tight pause at the top.
Volatile swings all year: rally, drop to a wick low, rise to year high, gap down from the top, sharp drop, rebound to MA200 with MA50 falling above. No coherent structure at the decision point.
Choppy year with a deep mid-year drop and partial recoveries; recent large up move on a volume spike, partly given back. Range-bound, no clear setup.

Strong uptrend and gap up in the first third, then eight months of very volatile sideways trading with crash wicks, a gap up to a new high, a gap down, and a final-bar large up gap. High volatility, no clean structure.
Volatile swings: early low, rally to a gap-up spike high, slump, recovery to a top range for four months, then a break below MA50 and MA200 to the middle of the range; small bounce at the end.
Base, gap-up breakout, strong advance to a blow-off top, crash wick, lower second top, gap down, then a slow lower-highs decline; decision bar breaking below the rising MA200 to a new post-top low.
Gap-up spike to the year high, drift lower, gap-down crash, partial recovery, second sell-off on volume; last two months a rally back above the MA50, still below the falling MA200.
Strong first-half uptrend, top range, then lower highs below a flattening MA200; final 3 bars a very large up gap on heavy volume back above MA200 (fresh gap; hold not yet established).
Strong uptrend for seven months, then a five-month high plateau with a flattening MA50; recent wide-range spike up and drop back to the MA50 on rising volume.
Early jump, eight-month range above a rising MA200, then a breakout to new highs in the last three months with a steepening MA50; decision bar at the high.
Orderly year-long uptrend with up gaps and higher lows; last month a pullback to the rising MA50 and a two-bar bounce back toward the high.
